_comment: Labelled calibration set for cmd/image-routing-calibration. Every PNG/JPEG under negative_roots at the checked-out commit is a fixture; a fixture is positive for a rule only if listed under positives, otherwise it is a negative for every rule. The set is versioned by the repository commit, which the generated report records together with the model snapshot and every resolved fixture's sha256.
